sections.h2: How to use a Under Armour promo code
sections.html:
1. Pick an offer above and tap Get code. The first time, enter your email and mobile to unlock codes, then copy it (deals and member perks need no code).
  2. Open underarmour.com, add the items you want to your cart and check they meet the offer's terms.
  3. Paste the code into the promo or discount box at checkout and check the price drops before you pay.

sections.h2: Tips for saving at Under Armour
sections.html:
• The ID.me discount can't be combined with promo codes, so compare which saves more.
  • Outlet codes such as EXTRA25 apply to selected outlet lines only.
  • Standard shipping is free over the threshold shown on the site.

faqs.q: Is there a Under Armour discount code right now?
faqs.a: Yes. As of 16 Oct 2026 we found a code on underarmour.com: extra 25% off select footwear & accessories in UA Outlet. Tap Get code above to unlock it. Codes can end without notice, so the store's checkout has the final word.

faqs.q: Does Under Armour have a student discount?
faqs.a: Yes: extra 20% off online for college students with UNiDAYS. Register and verify your student status with UNiDAYS to get the code. Online only.

faqs.q: How does VoucherVault check Under Armour codes?
faqs.a: We only list offers we have seen on Under Armour's own site or app, or in its official affiliate feed, and show the date we last checked each one. Offers with a published end date disappear when it passes; offers without one are hidden if we haven't re-checked them recently.

faqs.q: Why isn't my Under Armour code working?
faqs.a: The usual reasons are: the code only covers selected items, you haven't reached a minimum spend, it is for new customers or app orders only, it can't be combined with another offer, or it has just ended. Read the terms on the offer and check your basket meets them.
